run_quadruped_simulation: run the pybullet quadruped robot simulation with GUI and sinusoidal gait control
run_joint_control_demo: run the vision60 quadruped joint motor control demo with debug parameter sliders
run_gear_constraint_simulation: run the quadruped gear constraint simulation linking knee and motor joints
run_pybullet_urdf_loader: run the pybullet URDF loader to load and enumerate vision60 quadruped robot joints
run_realtime_gait_loop: run the real-time sinusoidal gait loop controlling all 12 quadruped leg motors
